in_arabic.name: جبريل
in_arabic.meaning: الله کا خالص ملائکہ، روح القدس، جبرئیل
in_arabic.long_meaning: جبريل اللہ کے بارے میں خبروں اور وحیوں کے لے آتا ہے۔ یہ نام ملائکہ کے بادشاہ اور اہم ترین رسول کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو قرآن اور اسلامی عقیدے کے مطابق اللہ کے آخری نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کو وحی لاتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: جبرئیل
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کا خالص فرشتہ، روح القدس، جبرئیل
in_urdu.long_meaning: جبرئیل اللہ کی طرف سے خبریں اور وحی لانے والا اہم فرشتہ ہے۔ اسلامی عقیدے کے مطابق، جبرئیل نے محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کو قرآن کی وحی دی۔ یہ نام فرشتوں کے درمیان سب سے اہم فرشتے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जिब्रील
in_hindi.meaning: ईश्वर का पवित्र दूत, आत्मा, जिब्रील
in_hindi.long_meaning: जिब्रील एक महत्वपूर्ण देवदूत है जो ईश्वर की ओर से संदेश और प्रकाशन लाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, जिब्रील को महादेवदूत माना जाता है जिसने पैगंबर मुहम्मद को कुरआन का प्रकाशन दिया।

in_pashto.name: جبراييل
in_pashto.meaning: د پاک د فرښتو، روح القدس، جبراييل
in_pashto.long_meaning: جبراييل د فرښتو پاچا دی چې د الهي پيغامونو او وحيو راوړلو لپاره کارول کيږي. په اسلامي عقيدې کي، جبراييل د حضرت محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم لپاره د قرآن کريم وحي راوړو

in_english.name: Jibrail
in_english.meaning: God's pure messenger, archangel, spiritual leader
in_english.long_meaning: Jibrail, also known as Gabriel, is an archangel in Islam who serves as a messenger of God, bringing revelations and messages to prophets. He is considered one of the most important angels in Islamic tradition, known for revealing the Quran to the Prophet Muhammad.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jibrail holds significant cultural importance in Islamic tradition, being identified as the angel responsible for delivering revelations to Prophets, including the Prophet Muhammad. This name is not only a part of the Islamic faith, but also a cherished and revered one in various Islamic cultures across the world.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic belief, Jibrail is considered a powerful and revered messenger of Allah. He is believed to play a pivotal role in conveying revelations and divine guidance to God's chosen prophets. The spiritual significance of the name Jibrail lies in the idea that it represents the gentle and compassionate nature of God, as He sends His messenger to guide and protect His people. By bearing the name Jibrail, one is reminded of the importance of following the divine guidance and sanctifying their actions with kindness and compassion, reflecting the gentle nature and mercy of Allah.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Jibrail is mentioned in the Quran as the angel who conveys God's messages to Muhammad. The name Jibrail carried significant weight in that era.
Jibrail is also mentioned in various Hadiths as the angel who taught Muhammad the prayers and other religious practices.

trends: Jibrail is a popular name for boys in the Muslim world.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jibrail remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Khadija Jibrail, a teacher in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, shares that their name Jibrail meaning "Gentle, Compassionate, Noble" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Jibrail is the Islamic name given to the Angel Gabriel. He is considered the primary messenger of Allah, conveying revelations to prophets, including Muhammad. Symbolically, Jibrail represents divine communication and revelation, bridging the gap between the divine and the human realm.
